strings.name: Marc Raibert
strings.summary: Raibert applied ideas from animal movement to robot balance and control. He built legged-robot research at Carnegie Mellon and MIT before founding Boston Dynamics in 1992. Its teams developed BigDog, Atlas and Spot. He later founded a robotics and AI institute to investigate how physical skills could be combined with autonomous decision-making.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founding Boston Dynamics and advancing dynamic locomotion influenced legged robotics and robot control.
strings.facts.f1.label: Research focus
strings.facts.f1.value: Dynamic balance and motion control in legged robots.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Electrical engineering bachelor's degree, Northeastern University (1973); MIT doctorate (1977).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Dynamic legged locomotion
strings.highlights.h1.text: Investigated hopping, running and balance control through the Leg Laboratory.
strings.highlights.h2.title: From laboratories to applications
strings.highlights.h2.text: Founded Boston Dynamics to develop robots with complex movement capabilities.
strings.timeline.t1.title: IEEE Robotics and Automation Award
strings.timeline.t1.text: Received the 2025 award for pioneering and leading dynamic legged locomotion.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Founding the RAI Institute
strings.timeline.t2.text: Established an institute exploring the combination of robotic physical skills and AI.
strings.timeline.t3.title: BigDog goes outdoors
strings.timeline.t3.text: Boston Dynamics' quadruped left the laboratory to investigate movement on real terrain.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Founding Boston Dynamics
strings.timeline.t4.text: Spun the robotics company out of MIT's Leg Lab.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Moving to an MIT professorship
strings.timeline.t5.text: Moved from Carnegie Mellon to MIT, continuing legged-locomotion research.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Establishing the Leg Laboratory
strings.timeline.t6.text: Created the Carnegie Mellon laboratory to study dynamically balanced robots.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completing an MIT doctorate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed doctoral work on motor control and learning.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Electrical engineering studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned an electrical engineering bachelor's degree at Northeastern University.
